entities.summary: Lisa Renee Foiles Cloninger is an American actress, presenter, video game journalist, model, author, and singer, who first came to prominence as a cast member of the Nickelodeon series All That, later voicing Jocelyn the Intern in the web series Desk of Death Battle, Death Battle, and DBX.
